title: Usoro ubi: obe na-achịkwa, ezigbo mkpụrụ na ule ziri ezi
course_title: Ngwakọta nke ugbo na nkwalite ihe ubi

say: Usoro ubi: obe na-achịkwa, ezigbo mkpụrụ na ule ziri ezi.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul 2 nke ngwakọ ọrụ ugbo na nkwalite ihe ubi.
A na-achịkwa mmepụta pollination. Ị na-ahọrọ nne na nna, ma gbochie pollen ndị ọzọ niile.

say: Nzọụkwụ 1. Na-ekpuchi oge ịse ntị na akpa égbè ozugbo ọ pụtara, tupu silk ọ bụla apụta.

say: Nzọụkwụ 2. Mgbe silk na-apụta, bee ya ozugbo n'ehihie, ma tinyeghachi akpa ozugbo.

panel.heading: Aka pollination na ọka
items: Akpa oge ịse ntị tupu silk egosi

say: Nzọụkwụ 3. N'otu ehihie, kpuchie tassel nna na akpa tassel ma tinye ya.

say: Nzọụkwụ 4. N'ụtụtụ echi, mgbe igirigi gachara, gbadaa tassel ma kpatụ akpa ahụ ka pollen wee daa n'ime ya.

panel.heading: Aka pollination na ọka
items: Akpa oge ịse ntị tupu silk egosi

say: Nzọụkwụ 5. Bulite akpa ịse ngwa ngwa, wụsa pollen n'elu silk, ma kpuchie ntị na akpa tassel.

panel.heading: Aka pollination na ọka

say: Nzọụkwụ 6. Dee obe na akpa na mkpado, nne mbụ, na ụbọchị.
Maka tomato, wepu anthers na nwa osisi tupu ya emepee. A na-akpọ nke ahụ nhụsianya.

panel.heading: Mkpụrụ a na-agwọ bụ nsi, ọ bụghị nri

cards.d: Ejila nri, ree dị ka ọka ma ọ bụ nri nye mkpụrụ anụmanụ nwere mkpuchi agba.
Yiri uwe aka, emetụla ihu gị aka, jiri ncha saa aka mgbe ị kụrụ.
Wepụ ụmụaka na anụ ụlọ. Ejighachila akpa mkpụrụ efu maka nri.

say: Yiri uwe aka mgbe ị na-ejizi ya, emetụla ihu gị aka, jirikwa ncha saa aka gị mgbe ị kụrụ ya.
